target_policy: Use the two original protocol-v1 loss targets without alteration; report first observed attainment at the fixed cadence, not an interpolated exact crossing.
clock_policy: Wall clock starts immediately before the first real optimizer update. Includes data waits, snapshot/proposal operations, target evaluations and logging; compilation and matched forward/application warmup are separate.
arms: same eight-H100 hero plus four-H100 drafter, one 16-update proposal
comparison_limit: One paired seed, exploratory timing; no equal-total-hardware resource-efficiency claim. No diagnostic continuation forks in these arms.
reason: Directly record time to fixed targets for the primary configuration after bounded component diagnostics; no algorithm or acceptance hyperparameter tuning.
